process_area.title: Value-Added Service & Financial Agency Product Setup & Partner Contracts

value_stream.name: In-Store Value-Added Services & Financial Agency Operations

Automation Opportunity: - Opportunity/footfall modeling; portfolio-economics analytics; charter-compliance check
Controls: - CTL-698 (ensure controlled execution — Value-Added Service & Financial Agency Product Setup & Partner Contracts (PA-156.1).)
- CTL-698: strategy agency-only (legal-validated VS-100.3); insight-sized; board-approved (VS-36)
Cross-references: - links to VS-33 (strategy), VS-07 (stores), VS-44 (insights), VS-22/VS-100.3 (compliance/legal), W4602–W4604 (partners)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Charter-overstep risk**: BuildRight acting as principal (lender/remitter) not agent → BSP exposure; mitigated by strict agency model & legal validation
- **Mis-sized-portfolio risk**: Services customers don't want/costly to serve; mitigated by insight-driven sizing
System Touchpoints: - Strategy (VS-33); store ops (VS-07); insights (VS-44); marketing (VS-14); compliance/legal (VS-22/VS-100.3); board (VS-36)

steps.activity: Commercial/Store Ops set the VAS strategy & portfolio (bills payment, remittance, e-money cash-in/out, mobile load), target stores (provincial/community), and the footfall/basket/commission model
Commercial/Insights size the opportunity (footfall lift, basket-linkage, commission revenue, cost-to-serve) using VS-44/VS-13, and define success metrics
Commercial/Legal/Compliance validate the agency model (BuildRight as agent, not principal) within retail charter/BSP rules, and obtain board approval (VS-36)

Controls: - CTL-698 (ensure controlled execution — Value-Added Service & Financial Agency Product Setup & Partner Contracts (PA-156.1).)
- CTL-698: aggregator BSP-licensed/solvent (VS-22); contracted w/ SLA (VS-100.3); biller accuracy validated; lifecycle managed (VS-67)
Cross-references: - links to VS-34 (procurement), VS-100.3 (legal), VS-22 (compliance), VS-67 (scorecard), W4601 (strategy), W4608 (integration), W4617 (settlement)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Aggregator-solvency risk**: Partner fails → stranded payments/reputation; mitigated by BSP-licensed/solvent screening
- **Biller-accuracy risk**: Wrong biller/amount posted → customer loss; mitigated by aggregator validation & SLA
System Touchpoints: - Procurement/DD (VS-34); legal (VS-100.3); compliance (VS-22); risk (VS-21.2); vendor scorecard (VS-67); IT integration (W4608)

steps.activity: Commercial/Procurement select the bills-payment aggregator/partner (BSP-licensed, solvency, biller coverage — utilities, telco, government, credit cards), screened via VS-34/DD
Commercial/Legal contract the aggregator (agency terms, commission, settlement, liability, data/privacy, SLA), per VS-100.3, and onboard billers per coverage
Compliance/Risk manage the partner lifecycle (solvency, conduct, biller accuracy), renew/exit (VS-67), and ensure BSP-compliant bills-payment operation

Automation Opportunity: - Principal-directory/licensure verification; float/settlement setup; AML/KYC agent tooling
Controls: - CTL-698 (ensure controlled execution — Value-Added Service & Financial Agency Product Setup & Partner Contracts (PA-156.1).)
- CTL-698: principal BSP-licensed (VS-22); AML/KYC as agent (VS-86/W4619); float governed (VS-18); lifecycle managed
Cross-references: - links to VS-22 (compliance), VS-86 (AML), VS-100.3 (legal), VS-18 (treasury/float), W4601 (strategy), W4617 (settlement), W4619 (AML)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Unlicensed-principal risk**: Partner not BSP-licensed → BuildRight exposed; mitigated by licensure verification
- **AML-exposure risk**: Remittance is high-AML-risk; mitigated by principal AML program + BuildRight agent KYC (VS-86/W4619)
System Touchpoints: - Compliance/BSP (VS-22); AML (VS-86); legal (VS-100.3); treasury/float (VS-18); procurement (VS-34); risk (VS-21.2)

steps.activity: Commercial/Compliance select the remittance/e-money principal (BSP-licensed EMII/REM/EMO principal, e-money issuer — GCash/Maya partners), screened for licensure/solvency/AML program
Commercial/Legal/AML contract the principal (cash-in/out agent terms, remittance terms, commission, float, AML/KYC obligations, liability), per VS-100.3/VS-86
Treasury/Compliance set up the float/settlement arrangement (VS-18/W4617), manage AML/KYC as agent (VS-86/W4619), and monitor principal conduct/solvency

Automation Opportunity: - Load-platform integration; commission/settlement automation; fraud monitoring (VS-125)
Controls: - CTL-698 (ensure controlled execution — Value-Added Service & Financial Agency Product Setup & Partner Contracts (PA-156.1).)
- CTL-698: telco partners contracted (VS-100.3); load integrity/fraud-monitored (VS-125); commission reconciled (W4617)
Cross-references: - links to VS-34 (procurement), VS-27 (IT), VS-100.3 (legal), VS-17 (finance), VS-125 (fraud), W4601 (strategy), W4617 (settlement)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Load-fraud risk**: Fake load/chargeback fraud (VS-125); mitigated by platform integrity & fraud monitoring
- **Settlement-mismatch risk**: Commission/load settlement errors; mitigated by reconciliation (W4617)
System Touchpoints: - Procurement (VS-34); IT integration (VS-27/W4608); legal (VS-100.3); finance (VS-17); fraud (VS-125); vendor scorecard (VS-67)

steps.activity: Commercial/Procurement select telco load partners (Globe/Smart/Sun direct or via aggregator), screened for licensure/coverage/commission
Commercial/IT contract & integrate the load platform (real-time top-up, commission, settlement), per VS-100.3/VS-27
Commercial/Finance manage commission/settlement (W4617), monitor load-transaction integrity/fraud (VS-125), and renew/exit (VS-67)

fields.Volume: BSP agent accreditation/licensing across the VAS portfolio

workflows.name: BSP Agent Accreditation, Licensing & Compliance Setup

Automation Opportunity: - Accreditation/licensing tracker; agent-of-operator document management; compliance-calendar
Controls: - CTL-93 (ensure VAS agency cash & BSP compliance.)
- CTL-698: BuildRight properly BSP-accredited/agent-of-operator (VS-22/VS-100.3); compliance duties documented; accreditations renewed
Cross-references: - links to VS-22 (compliance), VS-100.3 (legal), VS-86 (AML), VS-18 (treasury), W4602–W4604 (partners), W4619 (AML/KYC), W4620 (reporting)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Unaccredited-activity risk**: Operating without proper agent accreditation → BSP action; mitigated by accreditation & principal-oversight
- **Compliance-responsibility-ambiguity risk**: Unclear BuildRight-vs-principal duties; mitigated by documented agent-of-operator agreement

steps.activity: Compliance/Legal determine BuildRight's agent accreditation requirements (cash-in/out agent, remittance agent, bills-payment agent under BSP rules/principal oversight), and secure registrations/accreditations
Compliance/Legal/Principals establish the agent-of-operator relationship (BuildRight acts under each principal's BSP license/oversight), with documented compliance responsibilities
Compliance manage ongoing BSP compliance (consumer protection, AML W4619, reporting W4620, cash handling), accreditations renewal, and regulatory liaison (VS-22)

Automation Opportunity: - Contract/liability management; SLA dashboards; insurance/bonding tracking (VS-26)
Controls: - CTL-698 (ensure controlled execution — Value-Added Service & Financial Agency Product Setup & Partner Contracts (PA-156.1).)
- CTL-698: agency contracts clear on liability/commission/SLA (VS-100.3); insurance/bonding in place (VS-26); BSP-compliant (VS-22)
Cross-references: - links to VS-100.3 (legal), VS-22 (compliance), VS-26 (insurance), VS-67 (scorecard), W4602–W4604 (partners), W4617 (settlement)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Liability-exposure risk**: BuildRight held for principal/partner errors/fraud; mitigated by clear liability allocation & insurance (VS-26)
- **SLA-failure risk**: Partner underperforms → customer harm; mitigated by SLA mgmt & exit
System Touchpoints: - Legal (VS-100.3); compliance (VS-22); risk (VS-21.2); insurance (VS-26); finance (VS-17); treasury (VS-18); vendor scorecard (VS-67)

steps.activity: Legal/Commercial establish the agency contract framework (scope, commission, settlement, float, liability allocation, data/privacy, SLA, termination), per VS-100.3

steps.a: Head of Internal Audit & Risk / VP Legal
steps.activity: Risk/Insurance/Legal allocate liability (agent vs principal for loss/fraud/error), secure insurance/bonding where required (VS-26), and set liability caps/indemnities
Commercial/Legal manage SLA/performance, contract renewals/exit (VS-67), disputes, and ensure contract compliance with BSP/consumer-protection (VS-22)

fields.Volume: VAS counter design across target stores

Controls: - CTL-698 (ensure controlled execution — Value-Added Service & Financial Agency Product Setup & Partner Contracts (PA-156.1).)
- CTL-698: counter cash SoD-controlled (VS-08.2/VS-142); staff trained on KYC/AML/privacy (VS-86/VS-91); uptake monitored
Cross-references: - links to VS-07 (stores), VS-08.2 (cash), VS-19.4/VS-124 (L&D/enablement), VS-14/VS-152 (marketing/CSR), VS-134 (OCM), W4619 (AML/KYC), W4622 (analytics)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Cash-handling-risk amplification**: VAS adds cash volume → shrink/fraud exposure (VS-23/VS-142); mitigated by SoD & cash controls
- **Compliance-error risk**: Untrained staff breach KYC/AML/privacy; mitigated by mandatory training & gating
System Touchpoints: - Store ops (VS-07); cash mgmt (VS-08.2); L&D (VS-19.4); sales enablement (VS-124); marketing (VS-14); OCM (VS-134); CSR (VS-152)

steps.activity: Store Ops/Commercial design the VAS counter (at customer-service counter VS-07.1, cash handling VS-08.2, signage, queue), the staffing model, and the customer journey
L&D/Sales Enablement train counter staff on VAS transactions, KYC/AML (W4619), cash handling/SoD, privacy (VS-91), via VS-19.4/VS-124
Marketing/Commercial launch (signage, community comms VS-14/VS-152), with OCM adoption (VS-134), and monitor uptake/analytics (W4622)

Automation Opportunity: - VAS-terminal/principal integration; secure data exchange; analytics dashboards
Controls: - CTL-698 (ensure controlled execution — Value-Added Service & Financial Agency Product Setup & Partner Contracts (PA-156.1).)
- CTL-698: architecture EA-governed (VS-113); data secured & RA 10173-compliant (VS-91/VS-27.3); analytics governed (VS-28); retained per policy (VS-88)
Cross-references: - links to VS-27/VS-113 (IT/EA), VS-28 (data), VS-27.3/VS-91/VS-88 (security/privacy/retention), W4617 (settlement), W4622 (analytics)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Privacy-breach risk**: Customer transaction/KYC data exposed; mitigated by security (VS-27.3) & privacy (VS-91)
- **Integration-failure risk**: Principal/aggregator connectivity breaks → service outage; mitigated by robust integration & monitoring
System Touchpoints: - IT/EA (VS-27/VS-113); data (VS-28); security (VS-27.3); privacy (VS-91); finance/GL (VS-17); records/retention (VS-88)

steps.activity: IT/EA design the VAS systems architecture (counter POS/VAS terminal, aggregator/principal integration, settlement/reconciliation, GL posting), per VS-113
Security/Privacy ensure transaction-data security (encryption, secure principal exchange) per VS-27.3 and data privacy (customer PII, KYC data VS-91 RA 10173)
Data/Finance build VAS analytics (transactions, commission, footfall, basket-linkage) on the platform (VS-28), with data governance/retention (VS-88)
